name: Universal Exit TSL
description: Using Tradetron you can now build a strategy level Trailing Stoploss.
how_to_use_markdown:
Using Tradetron you can now build a strategy level Trailing Stoploss.

Search for keyword "Universal Exit TSL" in your Universal exit condition.

![Example](./images/img-1700648156.png)

Click on the keyword and select the inputs for TSL type, Activation, Lock profit, Increase profit by and Increase TSL by:

![Example](./images/img-1700648227.png)

![Example](./images/img-1700647855.png)

Select your TSL type:

TSL - Points will calculate all values based on rupees in PNL

TSL - Percentage will calculate all values in % of the capital mentioned

This is the start point of your TSL.

Example: If your strategy makes a profit of more than 20 rupees in "activate at", the TSL will begin only when your strategy makes a PNL profit of 20 and above.

This will exit your position if the price moves against you for more than the selected % or points from the activate at level.

Example: If your strategies TSL is activated at 20 rupees if the profit begins to move below 20 rupees, "Lock profit at" will exit at 10 rupees or 10% in profit.

Now add your "Increase profit by"

This is the minimum move in your favor before which the TSL will be modified.

Now add your "Increase TSL by"

The TSL will move by the points or percentage indicated here. Note: All values in this keyword has to be based on 1X multiplier.

parameters.name: Activate At
parameters.description: Favorable strategy PNL move before the trailing stop arms.

parameters.name: Lock Profit At
parameters.description: Distance behind peak PNL the stop trails at once armed.

parameters.name: Increase Profit By
parameters.description: Minimum further favorable move required before the stop is trailed again.

parameters.name: Increase TSL By
parameters.description: Amount the stop moves each time it re-trails.
